about: Every image on the OTTV homepage. All are original SVG illustrations made for OTTV and stored in this folder; the homepage uses no stock photos.

photosRemoved.note: The hero's four Unsplash photos (hero-cinema, hero-remote, hero-stadium, hero-popcorn) were replaced on 2026-11-11 by the original drawing hero-order-flow.

guideImages.note: The six setup-guide images (homepage guide cards and guide pages) are original drawings listed below as guide-*. src/lib/placeholder-images.json points each guide to its drawing. They replaced stock photos on 2026-11-11, after logos were found in three of them.
